Name: Look to the Sky
Author: drbirbdev
Description:
Press 'U' while outside to look at the sky.  If you have a slingshot equipped, you can shoot at things flying by.

Different things fly by at different times/seasons.

Certain ammo do special things.
[list]
[*]Iridium ore creates a star, which shines until the end of the day.
[*]Explosive Ammo explodes into a firework.
[/list]
